cd /workspace/tome4-chinese-translation; python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w39-20260926/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f5a2.json'))
p=d['payload']
for i,(t,b) in enumerate(zip(p['translation_snapshot'],p['bounded_context'])):
  if i==0: continue
  c=json.loads(b['context'])
  se=c.get('source_evidence',{})
  print('=====',i,t['revision_key'][:8],c.get('file'),c.get('line'),c.get('section'),c.get('source_tag'),se.get('component'),se.get('public_source_path'),se.get('matching_lines'))
  print('SRC:',repr(t['source']))
  print('TGT:',repr(t['target']))
  print('ADJ:',json.dumps(c.get('adjacent_translations'),ensure_ascii=False)[:600])
  extra={k:v for k,v in c.items() if k not in ('adjacent_translations','file','line','section','source_evidence','source_tag')}
  if extra: print('EXTRA:',json.dumps(extra,ensure_ascii=False)[:800])
"
